heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service category.

items.question: What web development services do you offer?
items.answer: We build custom websites and web applications using PHP, Laravel, CodeIgniter, WordPress, Node.js, AngularJS and eCommerce platforms, from simple business sites to complex portals.

items.question: How do I choose the right web technology for my project?
items.answer: We review your goals, budget, traffic expectations and timeline, then recommend the stack that fits best. Our team explains the trade-offs before development begins.

items.question: How long does a web development project take?
items.answer: A business website usually takes 4 to 8 weeks, while custom web applications take 3 to 6 months depending on features and integrations.

items.question: Will my website be mobile friendly and SEO ready?
items.answer: Yes. Every site is fully responsive, fast loading and built with clean, search-friendly code and on-page SEO basics.

items.question: Do you offer maintenance after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide ongoing maintenance, security updates, hosting support and feature enhancements.
